faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Yadgir Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the WCD Yadgir Recruitment 2026 is 25th August 2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the District Project Assistant and Block Co-ordinator posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the District Project Assistant and Block Co-ordinator posts by the Women and Child Development Department Yadgir (WCD Yadgir) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the District Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the District Project Assistant position, candidates must hold a Graduate Degree or a Post Graduate Diploma in Management, Social Sciences, or Nutrition. A minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for candidates applying for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the government's recruitment rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Block Co-ordinator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Block Co-ordinator post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 18000 to Rs. 20000, depending on the specific role and experience. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the WCD Yadgir Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for the WCD Yadgir Recruitment 2026. Both General/OBC and SC/ST candidates are exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for the WCD Yadgir Recruitment 2026 will involve an Interview, Document Verification, and a Computer Test. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the WCD Yadgir Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What are the essential skills required for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess good computer skills and have knowledge of both Kannada and English languages. For the Block Co-ordinator role, experience with technology and software application support is crucial.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Women and Child Development Department Yadgir, which is http://yadgir.nic.in. It is recommended to check the 'Important Links' section for direct access.
